persona: Native Indonesian woman, warm and patient motherly reading teacher. Conversational delivery, gentle encouragement, natural pauses and clear vowels. Keep letter and syllable demonstrations precise, without exaggerated acting.
note: Persona is selection guidance, not an API field. Audition quality must be reviewed by listening.

request.text: Halo, aku Bu Delia. Yuk, kita belajar membaca bersama. Pelan-pelan saja, ya. Dengarkan dulu. Ba. Bi. Bu. Bola. Ibu. Sekarang giliranmu. Ayo baca: ibu. Sudah cocok. Hebat sekali! Yuk, kita coba satu lagi.
